§6Accelerator Electromagnet Yoke§f

§aThe iron core of every accelerator magnet. You will need a lot of these.§f

Electromagnet Yokes are structural components placed inside LINAC and Synchrotron multiblocks. Each yoke forms the iron core of an electromagnet, providing the magnetic field that steers and focuses the particle beam.

Craft from Iron Ingots and Bioplastic. Bioplastic comes from sugar via the NC Manufactory. Simple recipe, but the volume required is not.

Yokes are spaced periodically along the beam axis. In a Synchrotron, they fill corners and straight sections. They increase power consumption and cooling requirements, but do not produce heat themselves.

§ePS:§f Combined with BSCCO coil wire, yokes form complete electromagnets. The stronger the coil, the more focus per pass.
